reviews.author: Bob Davies
reviews.text: The next patients' group meeting is on the 6th of May at 5pm. We established that patients can arrive a little early (say 10 minutes) to discuss individual problems/experience, so the PPG can focus clearly on shared problems. Whether you can attend or not, please write your review, good or bad, and I will continue to bring them to the new team. From the PPG meeting on Feb 4th... The practice is fully staffed for doctors (now at 6, and 6 admin) but doesn't have a practice manager as they're having trouble recruiting because they will also manage the Oldham practice. I have been assured they're wiring up a better fallback after 2 missed calls (most likely you will receive a text that asks you to ring the practice, but I have asked that a bookable slot picker be added too). The website is now 24hr accessible for admin/repeats, but still cannot be used out of office hours to request an appointment. The doctor has concerns about people using it for 'urgent' requests in the middle of the night (when no doctor is available to receive it), I've tried to make a case for it, but if out of hours appointment-requests is a blocker for you, please come to meetings and help me argue the case. I have also reraised when tests come back all green, but you're still sick, the practice currently close your diagnosis process until you re-engage (which you may not be told you need to do), which I intend to reraise in future. --- From the PPG meeting on November 26th... 2 new doctors are on board, and new staff are coming soon. Complaints about reception seem to be improving, less reliance on agency staff. The website will be switched to 24hr accessible. New Bank is on Bookable, which is much easier to use and is currently accessible outside of office hours (unlike PATCHS), but doesn't work for existing registered patients, and only has a limited number of slots and is only for booking an appointment. --- From the PPG meeting on 10th of September. The practice is moving to a new digital system on 1st of October, which 'should' solve some of the current technical issues with arranging appointments. Management say there will be some onboarding help and open/group sessions for anybody who would like to attend, and dates/times of those will be on a notice-board in the reception (or from Lynne, the operations manager) once those dates are arranged (probably a couple of evenings/saturdays depending on demand). We have also been assurred the quality of help from reception has been better in the last month and will continue to improve. There is still no new practice manager. They are recruiting for one in a difficult market, but they are adding new administrators (from October 6th, if I understood correctly) and _should_ soon be adding extra doctors too, with a less clear timescale (presumably notice-period related). The patient load on doctors is within the normal NHS range, so do not put off making an appointment just because you think they're busy, they have capacity and are adding more, and most of the problems seem to be steadily improving. --- After leaving a previous 1 star review with many negative points and being frustrated with being unable to arrange an appointment, I attended the newly set-up Patient Participation Group meeting (as a new management company took over in April) on 6th August. The discussion between the team and a few patients was constructive and the new management team seem to have an understanding of the problems after we explained in some detail. I also brought these reviews to their attention, and provided a breakdown of reviews to their management in the meeting. If you're here because you've had a negative experience, either recently or before the take-over, we've been assured they're working on it and should be moving to a new system, as well as dealing with the problems caused by specific staff. Please contact management with feedback and come to the patient meeting if you have the time, be heard, the new team are (it seems) finally listening, and they actually have a mandate to fix problems atm. Practice response date: a week ago Practice response: Hi Bob, Thank you for sharing the feedback on Patient Participation Group. We appreciate the time and effort patients like yourself give to attend meetings and providing their constructive input on how we can improve the practice. We invite all patients at the practice to attend the next PPG on 6th May to share their views. Thank you for highlighting the upcoming meeting and encouraging others to participate. Kind regards Jan Patient Services Team

Absolutely rubbish GPS gtd are unprofessional do not know what they are doing 🫩😡😤👎🏽🚫❌🚷⛔do not register here and plus there is no confidentiality with you standing there exposing your name dob and address etc as everyone can hear because they cannot be bothered have radio on so no one can hear . reviews.author: Saif Syed
reviews.text: The admin is terrible. Not doing their job. Referrals are not sent so you have to chase them after waiting for months. They never give a reason or explain why but they try to convince you by saying referrals are sent again where you have to wait more for a few months. NHS is already struggling but with these guys they make things even more long. It has happed a couple of times now for mum’s and daughter’s referral. I put a complain and it has been over 2 months and they don’t bother to do any thing about it as nobody has been in touch since then. We are going to move the whole family to another GP practice. If you don’t want headache don’t register with them, stay away because the staff there don’t care. Practice response date: 3 weeks ago Practice response: Hi, Thank you for your feedback and we’re very sorry to hear about the difficulties you and your family have experienced. We understand how frustrating delays with referrals and lack of communication can be, and this is not the standard of service we aim to provide. We also apologise that you haven’t received a response to your complaint. As we are unable to respond to individual issues on here, we would appreciate if you could please contact our patient services team so we can look into this for you. Please contact us either via email at gtd.feedback@nhs.net or telephone on 0161 337 2254. Thanks Jan Patient Services Team

reviews.author: Atal Jan
reviews.text: I’m really disappointed with the service at New Bank Health Centre in Stockport road. The customer service has been consistently poor, and the receptionist in particular has been very unprofessional during my visits. This was my third time coming in for an appointment, only to be told yet again that it had been cancelled. No prior notice, no apology, and no effort to help rearrange things in a way that was actually convenient. I understand things can happen, but the lack of communication and respect for patients’ time is extremely frustrating. Based on my experience so far, I can’t recommend this GP service

reviews.author: Hamdah Al Raisi
reviews.text: Very bad experience with New Bank Health Centre. The staff are rude and unhelpful. They ignore patients, spend time chatting and laughing during working hours, and don’t take our concerns seriously. Every time we try to get help, they rush the calls, don’t listen properly, and tell us to go to A&E without offering any real support. When we go to the hospital, they say to speak to our GP — it’s a constant cycle with no real help. This has happened not just to me, but to my whole family. We all feel ignored and disrespected. This is not how healthcare should be.

reviews.author: Aisha Akbar
reviews.text: The practitioner is ok. However I came into the centre because I thought I was going to be given some weight loss advice by a GP. But when I came in, I was taken by another doctor who asked me "how may I help you" without being told anything else. He checked the results of my recent blood test and all they did was check my organ function which they were generally all healthy and not my iron levels. I went for yet another blood test and still they haven't got back to me for my results. Not good enough.

reviews.author: Amara
reviews.text: After rearranging 2 appointments to attend a Drs appointment we sat waiting for roughly 35 minutes before being advised our appointment was cancelled. Due to our circumstances just sitting there in the waiting room for 30 minutes led to a lot of distress with my young one, along with the battle it took to get out the door and not even an apology from staff. This isn’t the first time but it will definitely be my last time at this surgery, beyond disgusting

reviews.author: Big Dude
reviews.text: The worst GP ever, anytime you book an appointment they ask you for pictures of your issue, like some issue are private you need to discuss with the doctor privately, if you can’t book an face to face appointment what’s the point of you have ing a GP? and if they ever give you an appointment face to face, the doctors don’t even listen to you properly it’s like they just can’t be arsed with their job, if you tell the doctor that you feel a certain way about a condition you got, and you think it’s a certain thing causing it they say yes this is it your right, so it makes you feel like their not even trying to look at your problem, whatever you say they say that’s it, it’s the same issue with all the doctors here, the worst GP ever been here for 3 years had enough, at times when you book an appointment even early in the morning, they don’t listen to you or reply back they just ignore you, until you call them back and they don’t even pick up the call and act like their busy

reviews.author: Mo Ali
reviews.text: Shocking patient service. Horrifyingly rude receptionists - they speak to you in a demeaning and condescending way and don’t bother to let you complete your sentence before cutting you off. Over the phone is a lot worse - because you’re not physically in front of them they think it gives them the right to speak to you like you’re a 2nd class citizen, absolutely backwards behaviour. Who will teach them some manners in dealing with patients? I manage in hospitality and let me just say - if my guests were dealt with the way your receptionists treat me (and others looking at these reviews), they’d receive disciplinary action straight away.

reviews.author: Klaudia Kania
reviews.text: The Worst GP in Manchester! I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the service provided by this practice. The level of care and professionalism is shockingly poor, and I’m genuinely appalled by the way patients are treated. The staff are not only unhelpful but often rude and dismissive, making it incredibly difficult to get even the most basic appointment advice or simply book one. Trying to book an appointment is an absolute nightmare. Instead of making things easier for unwell patients, the process adds stress, anxiety, and frustration. You’re passed between phone lines, broken websites, and conflicting instructions; and still end up with no appointment. It feels like no one takes responsibility, and the entire system is set up to discourage people from accessing care. Terrible experience, awful management. This practice desperately needs a complete overhaul.

reviews.author: Joyce Louis
reviews.text: I'm extremely disappointed with the recent changes at this GP surgery. I had a blood test scheduled but was given a date I couldn’t attend. When I managed to make time, the appointment was cancelled due to "unforeseen circumstances." The new system for ordering medication is also a step backward. It was previously simple to order through the pharmacy app, but now it's linked to the NHS app, which requires identity verification. Despite submitting my details, I'm told it will take several days for confirmation—followed by additional delays for dispensing and delivery. This puts me at risk of running out of essential medication, which is unacceptable. This level of service is deeply concerning. I will be looking to move to a more reliable GP surgery.

reviews.author: Javad Moazami
reviews.rating_label: 1/5 - Extremely DisappointingService Unfortunately, my experience at this clinic was very unpleasant. The behavior of the reception team was seriously unprofessional and disrespectful. On several occasions, they were either absent or busy with other tasks, leaving me waiting for long periods without any guidance. I was never informed that I needed to use the automated check-in system, and even if I had been informed, I would have required assistance. When I encountered disrespectful and insulting behavior, none of the reception staff paid attention to the issue, which caused significant distress and psychological pressure. It seems that the clinic manager is not paying attention to these problems and is not hearing the voices of patients. After sharing this review, I was surprised (and somewhat saddened) to find that several others had similar experiences at this clinic. Given how often such stories seem to come up, it might be worth taking a closer look—not just for me, but for others who may be facing similar situations. In fact, what I’m about to describe is only one of several upsetting experiences I’ve had at this clinic—and sadly, not the last. I am not sure whether this was racially motivated, but the way I was treated was deeply inhumane. I begged them to inform my doctor—who had been regularly renewing my weekly prescription for over a year—that I had run out of critical medication. They completely ignored me and, instead of offering help, shouted at me to leave the clinic. At that very moment, I briefly saw my doctor through a door behind one of the senior staff members—she appeared to say something to someone at a desk and then turned back and disappeared. Still, the staff insisted she wasn’t there. When I told one of the senior team members—who seemed to be in charge or at least more experienced than the others—what I had seen, she and her colleagues pointed at me, laughed at my desperation, and mocked me while I stood there in distress. After being kicked out of the clinic, I walked away with tears in my eyes, feeling utterly humiliated, unwanted, and hopeless. I was in a mental health crisis, and the lack of compassion pushed me to a point where I genuinely started thinking about ending my life. The pain of that moment hasn’t left me—it replays in my mind every single day. The medication that helped me cope was gone, and so was my sense of dignity. And this wasn’t the only time I was treated poorly. I had endured other incidents of disrespect and mistreatment before, but I didn’t know who to turn to or how to raise my concerns. So I kept silent. Eventually, I found the courage to tell my doctor honestly and emotionally what had been happening—only to be removed from the GP a few days later. No one should ever be made to feel that way in a place that is supposed to provide care.

reviews.author: Shadow S
reviews.text: This practice is one of the worst practices going. It USED TO BE good, offering same day appointments as stated on their website as long as we fill in the form within the designated time. But now it’s going downhill and after reading other reviews and realising I’m not the only one it’s made me feel even more frustrated. I filled a form in a couple weeks ago and I called up to make sure they’re received my form and they’ll be offering me an appointment the same day. The receptionist told me the doctor has received my form and will definitely call me back that same day. I waited and waited, I was so ill I fell asleep and when I woke up I realised they’re closed, I double checked my call logs and I didn’t receive a single call. This has happened to me before where I’ve been ignored by them which is why I called up this time to make sure they’ll definitely call me back. The receptionist falsely reassured me that the doctor would “definitely” call me back that same day. I felt I had an infection and needed antibiotics but they didn’t even bother. I needed an emergency appointment. I waited another day thinking they might’ve been busy but still no call back, I ended up getting better on my own without any support from the gp. I had to call in sick to work as I didn’t have any medication to make me better any sooner. I’ve been feeling ill again for the past week and I’ve not even bothered filling a form in or calling up to book an appointment because of how bad the service is and as I know I’ll just be neglected yet again. This isn’t how one should feel when in need of support. This practice really needs to fix up and get rid of all the slackers.

reviews.author: O A
reviews.text: The worst GP in Manchester. The appointments system is from 1965, where you have to wake up at 6am and file in the form online, or else they are closed by 8am. And then you sit until next day in pain without medication. If you fill the form for referal, they need 6 weeks to get it ready. When you try to follow up, the reception never answers the call, and when they do, they are absolutely rude, horrible and dismissive. They have zero care about the patients and if they are suffering or in pain. Receptionists sit there and just talk to each other and do not answer calls, making you wait on hold for 35 mins at a time. But when you visit the GP, its always pin drop empty. They create a scene, as if the GP is so busy, they need to closed appointments within 20 mins of it being open. They never investigate any issues that you have, just call you on phone and ask you to go to the A&E. Blood tests, they need 4 to 8 weeks to get ready. Terrible customer service, horrible behaviour, and zero regard for patients who are suffering in pain. Do not care if you need a referal urgently, just say the same thing over and over again - that you need to wait or the manager isn't working or the doctor is busy or they have a backlog. How about you answer your phones, open your booking systems for proper appointments. If you request a sick note, they will make you run around for weeks and make you even more sick. And after 6 weeks you get it, and its too late. It take 5 mins to type a referal letter or a sick note. Thats it. No more explanations required on this. Write, print and email the patient. They are just so lazy. They should not be getting away with this.

reviews.author: Naimo Adow
reviews.text: the new set up on online appointment is not user friendly and could be a barrier to people with some disabilities. the reception staff are rude and condescending.

reviews.author: OD
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars, I would! This GP is so shameless, that they have now even time-limited sending admin requests and sick notes as well. Just like the appointments. They are open from 8am to hardly 10am or 11am. Who makes them think that we are available during those times when someone is sick or at work or commuting?? Instead of making it easy for sick patients to book appointments and requests at their convenience, they stress you out more, make you more anxious and sick. Horrible management! In Liverpool and London, almost all GPs have open appointment systems, you can book appointments online and choose your date and time. Admin requests, medical reports and sick notes are processed within 48 hours no questions asked and they even deliver medication to your house! But look at these guys, they are operating on biblical systems and it is 2025!! Do yourselves a favour and please open up your booking systems. Its not that hard. Stop being so shameless! I will be reporting this GP to Health Ombudsman, NHS and MP.

reviews.author: M Naser
reviews.text: Unacceptable Service – Disrespectful and Unprofessional. I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the service provided by this GP. The level of care and professionalism is shockingly poor, and I am appalled by the overall treatment I’ve received. The staff are not only unhelpful but also rude and dismissive, making it incredibly difficult to receive even the most basic medical assistance. On several occasions, I have requested essential medical reports for both my children and myself, yet my requests have been consistently denied without any valid explanation or support. Despite providing clear documentation and emphasizing the urgency of the situation, I have been met with indifference and refusal to assist. The lack of respect and compassion shown by both medical and administrative staff is deeply troubling. This practice appears to have no concern for patient needs and is, in fact, actively hindering access to necessary healthcare. It is unacceptable that a place responsible for the health of the public is causing further distress to those who rely on it. I believe this GP practice must be held accountable for its failure to properly serve the community. I will be seeking alternative care and will be reporting this practice to the appropriate regulatory bodies. I strongly advise others to seek care elsewhere and avoid this practice at all costs.

reviews.author: Z
reviews.text: They cancelled a blood test appointment for my dad 4 times and then on the 4th cancellation were told to go to MRI for a routine blood test! No explanation given as to why and the receptionist put the phone down on us!

reviews.author: laura jeffs
reviews.text: Has improved a lot. Always able to get an appointment . Its much easier doing it online than by phone.

reviews.author: Caitlin Foy
reviews.text: Such poor service. They don’t listen to anything you’re saying about your problems. And if they do, they don’t help you out and give you anything to be at ease. They just throw blood tests at you constantly. Wouldn’t recommend whatsoever. When you do get an appointment they refer you to another practice. I tried contacting them via phone and still they just told me to fill out a form i already have done.

reviews.author: Rahul David
reviews.text: Worst GP practice ever. Been 2 months for my medical record and I still havnt recieved it. Suppose to be within 30 days. Now I cant work because I can't renew my badge.

reviews.author: Waseem Bashir
reviews.text: I am writing to express my deep disappointment with the service I have received from New Health Bank over the past 8 months. Despite being promised a referral for surgery in November 2023, I have yet to receive any follow-up. Each time I attempt to schedule an appointment, I am met with automated responses directing me to contact the orthopedic department myself, which I believe is the responsibility of the GP. My ankle fracture bone injury, sustained in June 2022, has led to severe restrictions in mobility, chronic pain, and significant weight gain, further exacerbating my health issues. The lack of timely intervention and support has left me feeling frustrated and neglected. As a patient, I expect more proactive and compassionate care. Unfortunately, my experience with New Health Bank has been quite the opposite.

reviews.author: Faiza Shahbaz
reviews.text: i always fill the form for appointment any time during day but I tried to fill the form today for my son.it's not allowed me to do that.when phone the surgery they said you have to do next day.there is possibility If someone cancel appointment and they have our request and they can deal with our request.

reviews.author: Ahmed Ali
reviews.text: Very disappointed. My wife had an appointment at 11 am. With ailing health reached on time.But when your self check in machine has technical fault waited fot the receptionists.The receptionists,one of them was over the phone and other was busy with something, two other patients were waiting for the receptionist.The receptionist check in and asked to be seated but later refused to see asked to come back after 3 hours. The staff must be trained accordingly. Doesn't know how to deal with the patients. Willing to wait for sometimes but refused completely.Don't you a little humanity within you ? Also sometimes,read the review,understand what the public thinks about you. Tried to reach the centre manager over the phone,"will send a text to your number to give feedback" was the response.Are you kidding with the pateints ?

reviews.author: Dominic Wedgwood
reviews.text: I have had nothing but positive experiences with this surgery. I did drop a star simply because you have to do everything via e-forms on the website, however my GP as well as the Nurse I see regularly are lovely and truly seem to care about my health.

reviews.author: christian careddu
reviews.text: i don’t know what to do no more. been waiting over a month for a referral letter to have access at my medications. the staff at the counter says to wait another six weeks??? while doesn’t let me speak with the practice manager, when she is basically there listening

reviews.author: Syed Joshim
reviews.text: I would like to express my appreciation for the outstanding care provided by New Bank Health. The team consistently helps me with my health conditions, and I am particularly impressed by their efficiency in scheduling same-day appointments. I switched from my previous GP due to unmet service expectations, but New Bank Health has exceeded my needs remarkably. My entire family has received excellent care, and we are very grateful for the support. Special thanks to Dr. Singh, Dr. Sawar, Sister Sarwar, and several other doctors for their exceptional service. Kind regards, Syed

reviews.author: Jayne Atkinson
reviews.text: Phoned for appointment told to go online did this & waited all day for a call describing my symptoms of severe pain down my leg and numb foot was told sounds like a hernia ? In my leg really & phone was put down on me, phoned next day a different doc rang me back told me to go xray depot and prescribed painkillers, still on going waited all day for sick note for work and still waiting, will be back on the phone Monday. Instead of telling us patients to go online for everything somebody needs to listen to us it's disgusting the treatment not everybody can go online. And who ever came up with online system you need to make it simpler and more understandable to use, keeps telling me my passwords are wrong. Rude, obnoxious, staff who repeatedly put the phone down on us.

reviews.author: Nabeeha
reviews.text: This surgery is getting worst day by day, i have to w8 for a blood test for 4 weeks, and when i went for a blood test waited there for half hr just to be told that nurse is not coming. So booked another blood after 2 weeks and got a call in morning that your blood test is cancelled today as nurse is not coming today as well.this sucks you have to w8 almost 2,3 months just to get a blood test.

reviews.author: Tobi Aligbe
reviews.text: IF YOU WANT TO DIE AND BE TREATED LIKE YOU ARE INSIGNIFICANT THEN YOU HAVE COME TO THE RIGHT PLACE. The receptionists are vile and diabolical when speaking to you. They are more focused on making tea and coffee and having conversations about patient's than actually helping the patient's. I was asked to ring the practice as they wanted to talk to me but when I do they refer me back to the website to go fill a form and to wait for a call or contact that never comes. I am dying slowly and painfully and I have been begging for help and answers for a problem I've had for more than 3 years and instead I get told if I can't wait then I should go find another practice. It's an absolute tragedy when doctors and nurses are happy to watch you die a slow and painful death.

reviews.author: Faiza Amjad
reviews.text: I requested a letter from GP and was not aware that this service will be charged as I never used this service before. Also no body informs me neither the GP or when I rang surgery they guy just simply said it’s ready for collection. When I arrive I have been told that I have to go back home and make payment over the phone. Once it’s been done, you can come to collect or we will post you. It’s natural thing if you are not aware of any thing you ask question what is this charges for? Which I did, in response I have been told that it’s private work and chargeable. Now second question, I was asking why I have to go back home and pay over the phone? Why I can not pay while I am here and take the letter with me. I was sick and don’t want to come back also Royalmail delivery services, everyone knows getting worse. So do not wanted to rely on that. Sharon who called herself manager, for sure does not deserve to be manager. She did not listen what I am saying, I was kept asking why I cannot pay now? She was cutting me off and I said listen to me please but she started shouting. “Why should I listen you, you have to listen me I am sick of these patients” I myself at least try to tell her my concern but she was so rude and did not have any customer service manners. Sharon ask other colleague to hand over my medical records print out. I tried to explain my concern to her but because of Sharon she refused listen me. Sharon’s attitude made me mad because I had a issue when people try to bully me, I got mad. I use abusive language for which I really feel bad but not for Sharon but her other colleague. She was just acting as she was being told by the manager Sharon.

reviews.author: Moe Yafai
reviews.text: The service in this GP service is below standards and unprofessional. As the patient you will be required to continually chase up what is needed and in my case of being disabled they systematically discriminate. To be fare, once getting an appointment the nurses and doctors are good but all appointments are by telephone

reviews.author: F Rashid
reviews.text: Awful gp practice. I have been suffering with health issues and have been trying to get an appointment for 3 days now. Yesterday I called and I was advised by nafees (receptionist) that there are no GP's in the practice and they work remotely. Then I requested a message to be sent to a gp to please call back as I would only require a phone consultation and he said just go to walk in or call 111 as he doesn't have the power to message them. I don't seem to understand why I should need to waste time on 111 a and e from my understanding if you have a gp why should you push the pressure on hospitals and 111 services? Reception staff need training. Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Polis Sidiropoulos
reviews.text: Incompetent manager and staff. I have been in this country for 15 years, and this is the first surgery/health center who questions a EU ID card. They welcome new patients but they do make you unwelcome and they are unwilling to help. They will even suggest you go to another GP!!! This was my second visit, I am left without my medication and will definitely look to escalate complaint to the right channels. To be honest, I am scared to meet their doctors now. If you get such service from the admin staff, what could you expect from the medical staff? I would advise for future clients to avoid at all costs. Manager should get the sack and staff must be trained to better serve clients. After all, we do pay our taxes and they get their salary from us. They are here to serve us. If they can't do a simple job like that, then they don't deserve to work in NHS. Any good rating will suggest it was done by one of their staff! We need to take action and try to replace these incompetent people with people who are ready to serve our needs.

reviews.author: Satvinder Singh
reviews.text: 11 AM Thu Nov 11 2022:- One of the worst GP Surgery. If there were any 0 Stars, I would have chosen the same. They are so inconsiderate and respond scripted statements. I kept on asking for GP appointment but they referred my daughter to a pharmacist. I haven't seen GP in last 3 years. In nutshell they don't want to work. 2:45 PM Nov 11 2022:- As per their stupid response, Pharmacist was going to call me. When checked with Pharmacist, they told me that they are not supposed to call anyone as it is not their responsibilities. Meanwhile, the receptionist at the New Bank Health Centre was so incosiderate that she said she will send me the number of Pharmacist through Text message (which i never received). This is how put ball in other's court to shirk off from responsibilites. They didn't gave me physical appointment as of now. 2:54 PM Nov 11 2022:- Called up two different Cohens Chemist, but both of them said my daughter has not been referred to them. God knows, where the surgery have referred, I think Rwanda!! 4:15 PM Nov 11 2022:- Visited Cohens Chemist they gave me Benzydamine Hydrochloride Spray (0.15% w/v) and charged me £4.99. I was forced to pay for the service which was supposed to be FREE.

reviews.author: Euan Gilchrist
reviews.text: I've been registered at this GP for over a year. Contrary to other reviews the staff have always been courteous and helpful both in the practise and especially so over the phone. Sometimes there is a short wait for appointments but this is typical across all GP services and is a small price to pay for the good service offered. Keep up the good work.

They do not care about their patients our tax money are being used for useless clinics and doctors along with their untrained receptionist. If I could give them lower than one star review would have done that but unfortunately can not do that. reviews.author: Abdul Hadi
reviews.text: This is the worst GP surgery in the country. Please avoid registering there. I'm suprised they are allowed to operate and still have a licence to practice. The staff are VERY rude, cude sometimes as well and online medical queries are answered (sometimes not even complete sentences) by receptionists. The other day I had filled in the online form to see my GP as they did not write a prescription I required as well as another query to see if my test results had come back. The person answering the queries (not a GP) simply go back to the pharmacy and ask for a replacement?! When they had said to me to ask the GP for an alternative. The surgery didn't even bother answering my other question; I had to contact them 3 times for a straight forword answer.

reviews.author: ADEEL MAHMOOD
reviews.text: So annoying and such waste of time! Repeatedly I am thrown between the GP and the pharmacy only to find out its the GP service which keep messing up my prescriptions! Just yesterday I rang to ask why only 1 item of my normal repeat was sent to the pharmacy , at which point I was told no it was 4. So I went to then pharmacy only to be told it was one, and they printed the prescription request out, which shows 1. I went back to the surgery and now they are saying oh i dont know why we said it was 4, we will put a request in to the doctors and it will be 2 working days! Never do they apologise for the consistent mess ups and treat me like i owe them a favour. And it isn't a one off neither. I hope there are some humans working there processing prescriptions hopefully realising patients don't enjoy running between doctors surgeries and pharmacies. Absolute disgrace, and I've been here for around 6 years now, for 1 year it was fine, other than that 5 years of just consistent miserable service. That said, the doctors, well most of them, are very good and a credit to the NHS.

But the other female doctor I have seen a couple of times I find is rushed, barely says anything- literally just hands you a prescription and that's it. Luckily the things I've seen her about are minor but if i had anything I was really worried about, I wouldn't look forward to the appointment. The ringing up at 8am is frustrating but at least you will get seen the same day.

The service they provide is horrendous. Call for an emergency appointment for my 3 year old son and they’ve said to put an online request, baring in mind I’ve told the person on the phone I’ve been advised by 111 and that 111 has tried to book an appointment for me and they couldn’t, my son has been poorly for 3 weeks and 111 prescribed him with antibiotics which didn’t work, any how I went and done an online request and I got an email back and when I tried to enter the date of birth to open the message it said it was incorrect and by the third try it locks the account. I rang the GP to explain the situation and they said to do another online form again, I asked them why couldn’t they just open the message on their side which could of been easier and my son could of been seen to by this point, I said this is ridiculous and the woman said ‘no it’s not’ with an attitude like a child, me a mother of a poorly child just need my child to be seen to and having to go through a process which could of taken 2 seconds.

Sometimes when they are stressed because the phone is non stop ringing can be amusing, but I wonder how they ever manage to up date anything on there computer. Practice nurse has been a god send at times when I can’t see a doctor. I guess what I’m saying is, doctors nurses and receptionists are not mind readers so if you know what you are feeling and where you are hurting tell them clearly. Not go round in circles seeing if you can catch them out. If at first the diagnosis is not correct don’t start being negative and blaming them, they can only work of what you have told them and not what you think is wrong with you. I had Alex hang up the phone on me, ignore phone calls from my number leaving me 1st in the que whenever I called from my number but when I hang up and call straight back with another number she'd answer, a few days went past and I tried calling again to ask for the manager Sharon, and my call was in the que when I was number 1 in the que and no answer, I thought let me call with another phone and join the que, as soon as I did she answered my first call cos now she had no choice but to answer cos she thought there's someone else in the que, the behaviour is appalling. Many times I've put a form in requesting to speak to my doctor I don't get through to her straight away when she's told me many times all I need to do is send her a message when I told her i do she told me she hadn't recieved it, so I started being adamant in my appointment requests that I want to speak to my Dr. I have filled in a feedback form and am still waiting to hear back from Andrew Gee or Lauren, but nothing, I'll probably have better luck getting Lauren to reply back to this post than my feedback form! When it clearly states on the website that if you have a complaint to fill in a feedback form or alternatively call to book an appointment, but when I called I was told the only way was to fill in a form (maybe because they know they can ignore your form!) I have been told to appeal a decision that I hadn't even received in writing, I've asked for a formal letter from them so I can complain to nhs England but still haven't recieved the letter because they don't want me to complain to nhs England or the ombudsman, but I will be going ahead with my complaints.

reviews.author: Sandra Bradshaw
reviews.text: Not even worthy of 1 star. Been suffering with an ear infection for weeks because I know it’s pointless trying to get an appointment. Relented Monday thru sheer pain and was sent on a wild goose chase of bein sent to a pharmacist, pharmacist sent me back to Gordon street where the receptionist said she’d resubmit my request to see a doctor. I was then sent a link to book an appointment… no appointments it said so rang receptionist back who then told me to keep trying the link for 4 days after 4 days if I’ve still not managed to get an appointment ring back and they will give me an appointment over the phone!! Fast forward to Wednesday and I’ve been accepted at a new doctor’s surgery, where I’ve had a telephone consultation, been prescribed an antibiotic spray and got a f2f appointment for Friday for a check up. Why is Gordon street accepting new patients when they can’t or won’t look after the patients they’ve already got. Absolute shocking place!! Avoid at all costs!

reviews.author: Chloe Bradshaw
reviews.text: If I could give this GP surgery zero stars, I would. Booking an appointment is an impossible task. When you finally do speak to someone, they fob you off to walk-in centres or hospitals that are already struggling. The fact it only has a 1.5 rating on Google says it all. Avoid registering at this surgery – it’s diabolical! I left years ago for the same reasons that are listed in these reviews, now nothing is too much trouble at my new GP. AVOID!

reviews.author: Martin Moran
reviews.text: Went for health check left me with pain in my arm popped my blood vessels in my hand using equipment wrong Practice response date: 3 weeks ago Practice response: Hi Martin, We are really sorry to hear that you are unhappy with the practice. Unfortunately we cannot respond to individual concerns here and we would be grateful if you could contact either the practice directly or our patient services team at gtd.feedback@nhs.net or telephone 0161 337 2254 so we can look into this further. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. Cate Patient Services Team

reviews.author: Jo Kiernan
reviews.text: The staff are lovely but can’t get an appointment for love nor money, and getting your prescription approved is a tad hot and miss too. Looking for a new doctor. Practice response date: a week ago Practice response: Hi Jo, Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback and for your kind comments about our staff. We are sorry to hear that you have experienced difficulties accessing appointments and with your prescription requests. If you would like us to look into the concerns you have raised in more detail, please contact the practice and ask to speak with the Practice Manager, or alternatively contact our Patient Services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net or 0161 337 2254 who will be happy to assist. Kind regards Jan Patient Services Team

reviews.author: John White
reviews.text: My partner recently went in for a medical appointment, after already expressing concern over the way she has been treated in the past and other people experience here. She called minutes after her appointment in tears due to the judgment and unprofessionalism experienced. Not sure what is in the water, but regardless of personal beliefs and differences medical professionals should always be professional. Making faces when discussing someone’s needs is never acceptable, especially when navigating difficult and sensitive topics. Once again disgusting behaviour, should be ashamed to be called practitioners. Practice response date: a month ago Practice response: Hi John, We are very sorry to hear of your partner’s experience with the practice and how upset she was following her consultation. No patient should leave an appointment in this way, particularly when discussing sensitive or personal matters. Whilst we cannot respond to this individual concern here, we do expect all our clinicians to act professionally, respectfully, and without judgment. The behaviour you describe does not reflect this and we take these concerns seriously. We would appreciate the opportunity to look into this further, therefore we would encourage you to either contact the practice manager to discuss these concerns or contact our patient services team either via email at gtd.feedback@nhs.net or telephone on 0161 337 2254. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Jan Patient Services Team

reviews.author: Mathew Lees
reviews.text: Made an appointment, doctors had a family emergency. Was sent to a different surgery, was asked to book a blood test at Gordan street. Referral to sleeping specialist in north Manchester hospital. Receptionist told me their are no sleep clinics in the north West on NHS, but she will try and get me in at warrington general. Was refused a blood test to check for heart disease by Receptionist even though a doctor's asked me to. It is hit a miss with the Receptionists. Doctors are great though if you can get an appointment Practice response date: 2 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

reviews.author: Ewelina Hartung
reviews.text: Really bad experience. Sent repeat prescription request via patches and got wrong medication prescribed 3 times in a row(!) I have been assured in person, after I described the issue at reception and informed I have only 1 tablet left, that next prescription will be signed and send immediately. I called in next day afternoon just to be informed they have 48h to send it. So I waited with no medication left. I got a call next day to be informed that my request was refused as I need to see GP for check first. I believe I should be informed about it when send my initial request weeks ago. Nevermind, nearest app was scheduled in a week time. I waited. It is hard to believe, but when I turned in for the appointment it turned out it was contraception app with nurse, and not for the med I requested and she couldn't release my meds, as it could be only done by GP. 🤡 After a month of struggle I was again at point 0 with no meds. Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are experiencing isues with your prescription. Your comments will be passed on to the practice manager. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

reviews.author: Meg Wood
reviews.text: Absolute shambles of a practice. Never any appointments available . Went for a blood test last week and I was the only person in the waiting room, but no GP available for appointment. They do not prioritise really sick patients whom should be given priority . You cannot get past the receptionist. When I asked reception to send a message through to GP she said no because GP was busy & no appointments. I said I didn’t necessarily need one I just wanted to relay a message with a query but it’s not possible. I have worked for NHS for 26 years , and in GP practices and never ever found receptionists to rule the surgery . The GP’s there are mainly locums and haven’t a clue what’s going on & the difficult time patients are having. Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are experiencing issues when making appointments. Your comments have been passed on to the practice manager. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

reviews.text: Absolute joke!!! Been put on weekly prescriptions and every week without fail I have had some kind of issue!! Left without medication for days, rude receptionist (only one,the rest are lovely) seen few weeks ago by the nurse for something that clearly warranted a GP appointment, told I'm on a specific medication (thyroxine) even though I have NEVER been prescribed it!! Nurse continued to argue with me telling me I was wrong, untill I told her to check my details and turned out? She had the wrong patient on the screen!! This has happened before at this practice wherea GP rang me to inform me they were reducing one of my medications due to me being 12 weeks pregnant!!! I wasn't pregnant at all, wrong information AGAIN!! The list goes on and on and on!!! Sent by the nurse for an msk scan.....got there to be told I wouldn't be having no such scan because what the nurse had written in the referral? Was completely incorrect!!! reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: Doctors are great! However, even though you constantly ring from surgery opening, it is not guaranteed you'll get through! Then when you eventually get answered an hour later, appointments have all gone! Doesn't matter that you're ill, you can't have one, until next week or wait to go through same process all again over again! The old system was so much better! 4 years on from this review, the surgery has become, not fit for service. I received a text, to make urgent appointment, so I ring, and no appointments available. Ring following morning, as soon as phone lines open, and told I'm 20th in the queue to speak to receptionist. Yeah, right! Not only, have I waited for 2 months for results, I can't get an appointment. I was told at one point, they were delayed, and they would only contact me, if they showed something. I have no faith in any of them, anymore! Even the consultants at the hospital, roll their eyes, at the mention of this surgery, now! It used to be, one of the best. Now it is probably the worst. An update 24th March 2025. Gordon street medical centre is now, no longer taking appointments over the phone or over the reception desk. Told to access on line, by text, with no clear instructions on how? I'm certain there'll be unnecessary deaths, through this total lack of care, and receptionist has put the phone down on me, just for asking her name. My husband has physically approached reception, and has come home with zero help. I will be making official complaint! Practice response date: 11 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are unhappy with the service received. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

reviews.author: Adam Tomkow
reviews.text: I have never been able to get an appointment. I get told “why not just go to the walk-in centre at Tameside Hospital” 3 hours waiting at Tameside Hospital for a 30 second chat with the DR, I was told I shouldn’t have come here as I need blood tests. Phoned Gordon Street Medical Centre the day after to be told there’s no appointments and try again tomorrow. Also advised not to go down in person at 8am either. My appointment is “routine” and I am happy to have an appointment in 1 weeks time, 1 months time, 6 months time... What a broken system. Tameside hospital advised me to phone 111 if my local GP doesn’t help. Seems extreme and a waste of peoples time who are dealing with emergencies. Practice response date: 11 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are unhappy with the service received. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

reviews.author: Klaudia Cooney
reviews.text: Worse practice by far, cannot ever get an appointment and only thing they ever say is to go to walk in. Managed to get seen once in last 3 years which tells you a lot. Infection in foot and can't walk- go to walk in, chest infection and need antibiotics- go to walk in, pregnant and need to get chest checked out you guessed it- go to walk it. I honestly don't even know why I bother phoning. You can phone bang on 8:00 still be number 40+ in a queue, wait for about hour to be told there is no appointments! Absolutely shocking and all you get asked is why can't you go to walk in ? Because I got advised not to as to not spread and pick up any more germs (high risk pregnancy but who cares the practice certainly does not) Practice is literally 2 min away from my house and I couldn't even tell you what it looks like 🙃 Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. reviews.author: Danish Mumtaz Mirza
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with this surgery. I called to book an appointment for my 3-year-old daughter, and the lady who answered the phone was extremely unprofessional. She was dismissive, impatient, and made me feel as though my concerns were not important. I expect a certain level of courtesy and empathy when dealing with a healthcare provider, especially when it involves children. I understand that surgeries can be busy, but there is no excuse for such poor behavior towards patients or their families. I would not recommend this surgery based on the lack of respect and customer service I received. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are unhappy with the service received. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

reviews.author: Peter Saunders
reviews.text: Absolutely shocking but looking at other reviews they clearly don't care. Almost impossible to get an appointment and reception staff that are obstructive and deny the conversations that they have had with you. Was promised a call from the GP at 10 am to discuss test results that had been with him for 2 weeks - apparently that was the earliest that he could spare 5 minutes on the phone - but no surprise the call didn't come. I called in and was told that I would be called before 1pm and even though I was definitely speaking with the person who promised 10am., she denied it. I've wasted hours of time with this practice, taking time off work simply to spend hours trying to make appointments and get results but they don't appreciate that people work.I still dont know whats wrong with me yet they have sent a prescriptionto the pharmacy without me knowing what it is for..the caring profession? Yeh, right. Useless Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are unhappy with the service received. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

When I finally get to do my tests the feedback I get is awful. Really poorly trained staff and no specialists since Julie left. reviews.author: ulysses thirteen
reviews.text: Following the structuring of the surgery and old GPs retiring, what was a great practice is now a Kafkaesque nightmare with some of the worst receptionists I've ever come across, in fact amongst worst public facing staff I've ever come across. Literally nothing to recommend about this surgery now. Often takes 3 or 4 weeks to get an appointment via the 8am rush and despite claiming to be able to make online appointments it's next to impossible. Been a patient there since 1990 and sad to see it go downhill so badly.

reviews.author: Kal
reviews.text: The reception staff are rude and it is impossible to get an appointment. Even when the doctors tell you you need a follow up appointment and to see the reception they tell you to call next week. When you call next week they say there are no appointments. I was waiting there once when an elderly gentleman wanted to make an appointment and said the same thing that he can never get an appointment over the phone the reception was rude to him and told him there was nothing they can do. Then when he left they were all giggling behind his back. Not very professional at all.

reviews.text: Doctors and most staff are incompetent (not including the nurses) they will leave you without anticonvulsant medication for 5 days, even though they know how dangerous it is to stop taking them abruptly. One receptionist is really polite, respectful and will do her best to help you. It's a shame that the rest of the staff including doctors don't seem to care. Avoid at all costs, you deserve better care.

reviews.author: Hazera Rahman
reviews.text: Rang at 8, opted for call back. Received call back at 8.40 to be told no appointments left or pre-bookable to go through urgent care instead. Another fob of system! How does this work is beyond me. How do you get seen for non urgent issues that can require a wait but still need to be seen by a doctor as issues have not been resolved with pharmacy or other avenues. It’s becoming very frustrating how opting for a call back and retaining a position in the que first thing in the morning still requires me to call back tmrw for an appointment the next day. How you don’t have pre-bookable is beyond me they should bot be embargoed that’s the whole reason for a pre-bookable!

reviews.author: Hena Hussain
reviews.text: This is the worst medical practice ever!! My husband has had a severe problem for a MONTH. He went to give samples in and they still haven’t got back to him as they claim they have the results but a doctor needs to give them to him. How is a doctor supposed to give it to him when appointments are booked for the next two weeks!!! He’s in severe pain and waiting makes us more anxious it will lead to further problems frown the line .They could at least give the results and put our minds at ease. We’ve been waiting a month for an appointment ringing every morning at 8am and the through tour the day with no availability. It’s utterly a joke. reviews.author: Lee Staniforth
reviews.text: I moved here from another Ashton GP. This surgery is far better! I've always found the reception team polite. I'm now in my 50s and the docs are more interested in me... I have no issues with Telephone Consultations, though I would prefer they be close (within 10 mins) to the booking time.

reviews.author: Secluded
reviews.text: Reception are always nice, it’s the doctors who don’t listen that I have a problem with. I’ve been suffering from extreme fatigue, and an insane amount of pain for a long time now. It’s gotten to a point where i barely leave the house, miss most important events, and extremely fed up. The doctors have blatantly ignored everything I have told them, they seem to only deal with the easy cases. They are also convinced being young excludes you from being unwell. Do not use this doctors, they will ruin your health.

reviews.author: Suneeta Patel
reviews.text: The receptionist are incredibly rude, you have to die before an appointment is available. I received a text for a smear booked, when I got to the surgery I got a nasty surprise that my appointment isn’t due until 2025 nevertheless sent a email but no response. But some GP’s are ok at that surgery but that’s all I can say.

reviews.author: Maxine garratt
reviews.text: Rang bang on 8am last Monday morning, desperate to see a GP after being ill all weekend. Still only 8th in the queue. Managed to get a phone appointment with a locum. This lead to a face-to-face appointment with the same locum. She was the ONLY GP in the building. The practice has 4 or 5 consultation rooms, but during, and since, the pandemic, the doctors I saw before 2020 have vanished. No personal service. No continuity of care. No follow ups. In fact, I'm supposed to have a blood test every six months, but haven't had one for about 3 years.

reviews.author: Esha’s World

reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars I would. Receptionist staff terribly unpolite and unprofessional shocked they still in job. Been ringing everyday past 3 weeks everyday it’s caller number 25 and never managed to get appointment.

reviews.author: Mahesh Singadia
reviews.text: Rang this morning and thought yes I’m caller No1 Or great I’ll get to be the first to get answered!! After 10min thinking why nobody’s answered yet 15min!! Right I’m going to the surgery and find out why they have not answered me? Got there with my phone banging on the front door! And one of the staff come out and told her I’m caller No1 why haven’t you answered me?? And I’m there sticking my phone in her face with the message still saying I’m caller No1!! Your not going to believe what she said firstly there was no apology and then! She says WHILST I’M HERE TALKING TO YOU I CAN’T ANSWER YOUR OR ANYONE ELSES CALLS!!!!!!!!!!!! WHAT??? I was caller No1 for 38min and was eventually answered by the same receptionist soon as I got back to my car!!

reviews.text: this medical practice need a New managment system impossible to get an appoinment to see GP, They suggest Onlice service But also they have poor Patient acess system.. totally rubbish service.

reviews.author: Bebaa Ranii
reviews.text: Can never get through, you have to ring at least 90 times constantly until you get through to be told there is no appointment. Even for a non urgent appointment you have received a text about BY THEM you have to ring at 8am. They can make our and their own lives easier by pre booking them and ringing at any time insted. The booking system is pathetic!

reviews.author: Stephen Grubb

reviews.author: Nicole K
reviews.text: It was suggested to me in my very own private appointment with test results & support that my son may need some further help years ahead as he was too young to be diagnosed at the time or have a referral made, so I then asked his primary school for the extra help with also a false accusation made against me to the authorities, this is becoming like an obsessed safeguarding problem full of inappropriate questions for single parents that only want the best for their children to succeed in education, I would of appreciated some help with this, also I don't think it's fair on undiagnosed but suspected earlier on that children should be made to go to the walk in with anxieties/refusals due to NO discipline or help in these schools that do not support or deal with bullying fairly, making it difficult for me again, then I have to make an appeal to change her enviroment so she feels safe in her surroundings & I reckon they should be allowed to see a nurse or GP ASAP!!! with any self harming issues that are discussed, bringing the parent into this & making them feel like they are the problem is nothing but stressful when they have enough on their plate to attend with- more refusals, no diagnosis or written plans. So please improve on children's referrals & appointments it's not too much to request, it should just be a speedy check up not a rejected one then accused of not taking my child for help being pressured by 4 people that know nothing about child abuse, quite racist actually when she is naturally fair with dark hair & can't get into a decent sleeping routine or leave the house without me, it's not always appearances all the damage is recorded in the information & should of been passed on to Early Years meeting as they thought I just leave her with no help, I've been requesting help from you for years then the replies are go to the school with these questions how can that be done when they all put safeguarding above everything else, as a child i was severely neglected & abused, I know exaclty what it looks like & others should know aswell how it appears from the outside, so this is one big joke & hopefully, one day the supported well cared for children get all the help they need to manage well through life, things need changing, parent blaming is nothing but delaying & unfair. Practice response date: a week ago Practice response: Hi Nicole, Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to read about the concerns you have raised and the difficulties you describe in accessing support for your child. As we are unable to review or discuss individual circumstances through Google reviews, we would encourage you to contact the practice and ask to speak with the Practice Manager who can look into the support the practice can offer you and your child. Kind regards Jan Patient Services Team

As for myself, I have a pregnant woman’s full details wrongly sent to me including , consultation history an anti sickness prescription sat on my patchs account for weeks even after I had rang the reception to complain about it and request for this information to be deleted. My wife hasn’t been left out of their poor service, she had an episiotomy during childbirth in September 2025 and was stitched which resulted to an overgranulation, we’ve complained about it to the GP, she was seen my the midwife 2 weeks ago who said she was going to refer my wife to the Gynaecologist and as of now, no referral, no update! reviews.text: This place should be shut down. They've effectively managed patients away, and if you need a repeat prescription you may as well talk to a horse! They don't sign anything off and don't tell you... And this happens every month! I once had to go in 6 times in a single day and said I wasn't leaving until I got the vital medication my mother was waiting for. Reception staff (mostly) fob you off and seam incapable of realising the seriousness of the surgeries inefficiency (and I would say neglect) is causing. If you phone at 8am you'll be caller number 25 in the queue and be waiting an hour to see speak to someone who'll try and fob you off. Then you never see a doctor eventually anyway... Just a nurse practitioner, but they don't tell you this. The worst issue is repeat prescriptions though... It's just stressful having to deal with them. They don't help, they're a massive hindrance. reviews.author: Sylvia Chan
reviews.text: I seriously question the purpose of having a GP like this. Every single time I try to see a doctor, it is extremely, extremely, extremely difficult to get an appointment. In the past, they allowed walk-in appointments before 8 a.m., but this was later cancelled. Phone appointments were also available before, and then cancelled as well. They introduced a so-called “new system”, which I tried to use by filling in all the required information, only to be told that it was not possible and that I should make an online phone request instead. When I called the GP surgery again, I was told that this system is only open between 7 a.m. and 11 a.m. As a result, my illness was delayed for over a month and a half, and up to now I still cannot access my GP properly. I even went to other GP practices, but they simply referred me back to my local GP, which is this one. Thinking back on my past experiences, I honestly cannot recall a single time when I successfully booked an appointment and saw a doctor smoothly. On my very first appointment, I clearly booked a face-to-face consultation, but it was changed to a phone consultation without my consent. Because I was at work and missed the call, my appointment was immediately cancelled. When I later went to the surgery in person, I was told that my appointment could not be found in their system at all. I genuinely do not understand whether this GP surgery is functioning properly on a daily basis. In my opinion, the management and organisation are highly unprofessional and incompetent. Additionally, during a previous consultation, I explained to the doctor that I suspected two possible conditions. I then saw the doctor searching for symptoms on Google during the appointment. This made me seriously question the level of professionalism and medical competence. Overall, this has been a deeply frustrating and disappointing experience.

reviews.author: J
reviews.text: What a joke of a place. Had to attend to a blood test appointment for my young boy and they cancelled my appointment because we didnt apply a numbing cream. They stand that this is mandatory in their policies. Zero empathy for a family that had to book days off from work and travel long distance just to get the appointment cancelled and reschedule. Numbing cream which has zero to none effect and is not mandatory in any other clinic. My little boy has had many blood tests before and never had numbing cream since he was a baby. I understand this is preferred but to make it mandatory and cancel an appointment based on this is relentless and shows no empathy at all. Please avoid this clinic at all cost if you have the chance to.

reviews.text: I had an appointment with a nurse who was completely incompetent and didn’t know the correct procedures. She claimed to have checked everything with the GP, but neither of them examined me or took any proper steps. I was simply told to contact my consultants secretary — even though I repeatedly explained that they needed to refer me back for an appointment. After leaving the surgery, I called my consultant’s secretary who confirmed I was right — my GP needed to make the referral request. This meant I had to go back into the surgery to explain everything again, only to be told they weren’t sure if they could do it and would “write to them” about my examination, to which I questioned as no examination had taken place. Now I’ve been told I need another GP appointment just to have an examination that should have been done the first time. The whole experience was a complete waste of time. Poor communication, lack of basic competence, and no accountability. Avoid this surgery if you can.

There is no care whatsoever within this practice, it's hard work trying to get seen by a Dr, it's always a nurse who sometimes can't deal with your illness. I could go on but it's pointless because you don't care. This surgery needs investigating as a matter of urgency because patients are being neglected on a daily basis. reviews.text: It has been extremely difficult to get an appointment with this GP practice since the pandemic. reviews.author: Ken Kamdy
reviews.text: A call was initiated to ascertain why an appointment for a mother and child was declined by a GP, providing clinical advice to the service user, and you are not part of the medical team. NHS staff must not unreasonably deny access to services, and patients are entitled to be treated with dignity, receive clear information, and file a formal complaint regarding inadequate care or discourteous conduct. However, a staff member and a receptionist unjustly canceled an appointment, and I have requested the call log. Non-clinical reception staff should not act as if they are GPs; clinical decisions regarding whether a baby or parent requires a review should be made by a qualified health professional (GP, nurse, ANP) following appropriate triage protocols. Professional guidance underscores that healthcare professionals must not unreasonably refuse a patient access to care that addresses their needs and must communicate with kindness and clarity, particularly with vulnerable patients such as parents of very young children. A receptionist informing a practice or service user that she does not consult a GP also provides clinical advice to the service user. Merely asserting that a one-year-old “does not need to see a GP” without a proper clinical evaluation or justification is unlikely to adhere to good practice standards regarding communication and access to care. It is unfortunate that this matter is not being addressed; I intend to escalate this issue further due to the appalling service. Practice response date: a month ago Practice response: Hi Ken, Thank you for taking the time to share this feedback. We are sorry to hear about your experience and understand how worrying it is, particularly when there is a young child involved. We take concerns of this nature very seriously, however we are unable to investigate or discuss individual cases here. We would really like the opportunity to look into this for you, therefore please contact either the practice directly and speak to a manager, alternatively contact our patient services team either by email gtd.feedback@nhs.net or telephone on 0161 337 2254, so we can investigate your concerns in line with our complaints procedure. Thanks Claire Patient Services Team

reviews.author: Fiona Simpson
reviews.text: I am always really happy with and satisfied with all interactions with the surgery, and actually recommend it to others. The 2 main doctors and advanced clinician are always very good and are through, listen and take concerns seriously. The patches system is very good and easy to use - myself and spouse have had to use it a few times recently, and we have always then been contacted with an appropriate appointment, if that was face to face, urgent phone, or routine that has always happened quickly. There are some people complaining about lack of appointments etc, I have never found this to be the case. I work in primary care and regularly deal with different GP surgeries, and believe me, simpson medical are one of the better ones!! Perhaps everyone needs to have realistic expectations, and consider that there is high demand for healthcare, which exceeds capacity. The old days of face to face appointments are gone, unless it is necessary this does not happen anymore - often phone calls, including photos etc are often sufficent, and more a more efficient use of staff resources. If a face to face appointment is necessary it will be made whilst anything regarding mental health has always been taking seriously and urgently. I am very happy with being a patient here, and think given the demand they do a good job, and are one of the better surgeries I deal with. Thank you to the staff, I appreciate it Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your lovely feedback. It's good to hear you have received great service. reviews.author: Mark Cole
reviews.text: Good afternoon I would like to give you some feedback on my experience, but I would like to do this in a respectful, fair-minded way. I hope you take it in the spirit in which it is offered. I am a long-standing blood donor. I was unable to donate at my last appointment. because of a low Iron level. Their protocol determined I should have a follow up blood test at my GP. I attempted to book this at the practice but was told it would need to be authorised by the GP, this is understandable. I attempted to do this through PATCHS. The first two days this was not possible as there was no capacity in the system. This was the same on the third day, but then at 12.00 midday I managed to access then system. Not sure when it clears? I assumed the beginning of the day? PATCHS was then excellent, and a blood test authorised within the hour. But attempting to make the appointment was more problematic. 3 days, about 10 attempts, different times of day, on the phone for a total of around 3 hours could not get through. Some of these the automated service said I was first in the que. Based on how long I was waiting I have some doubts about this. In the end I walked to the surgery and made the appointment face to face. There were two receptionists, not unpleasant, but quite “minimalist” in their interactions, empty waiting room, they were not do anything that would have prevented them from answering a phone. Not sure if these are people responsible for incoming calls? Appointment was made, the earliest available was 18 working days. I guess I am lucky it was routine. Having worked in public service, including healthcare for 50 years I do appreciate there are often hidden complexities that the public may not see. But overall impression. Some parts of the system seem to work and some not. Could the donation centre have taken my blood? PATCHS works well when you can access it. Incredibly hard to get through to the GP. Long appointment wait for something that feels very routine and quick to do. When I am seen, based on previous experience I every confidence that it will be efficient and the staff respectful. But it feels it is harder than it should be and with some concentrated thought some opportunities for quick wins here. Practice response date: 7 months ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you have been experiencing issues with Patchs and arranging appointments. Your comments have been passed on to the practice manager. If you would like to discuss your feedback further, please either contact the practice directly and ask to speak to the practice manager or contact our patient services team via gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

I’m having to have out of hours appointments at other practices as this one is unable to accommodate. I only joined this practice as I moved out of the boundary of my old practice, and now I’m currently looking for another doctors as I’ve had the same ongoing issue for 3 years with no help from this practice. Doctor kept asking receptionist to call me saying there is not any point in me attending, after 3 phone calls agreed to see me. As soon as he entered he was dismissive, rude and downplayed my health, basically said there is nothing that he can do if I were to get worse. Stated that my chest is totally clear and I'm perfectly fine. Such a contrast to the 111 Doctors and Nurses I spoke to; its always best to over-care than under-care. My health conditions are lifelong and individuals like this are the ones who make me lose confidence and put my life at risk as I can't trust them to have 1% of humanity or at least fulfil their DUTY. reviews.text: No-one ever seems to write positive comments. When service is good few people ever review so I want to share my experience. I have had nothing but great service from this GP practise. The receptionists, practise nurse and doctors have been nothing but professional each and every time I have visited them. The receptionists have always been so helpful chasing repeat prescriptions, test results etc. When the walk in centre was here it was manic due to countless people waiting but as this has now moved to the hospital it is much calmer. I want to say thank you to all of the staff here, you do an amazing job in difficult circumstances. The NHS is a wonderful thing and people should remember the receptionists doctors and nurses are people too - don't take your frustrations out on them they are human and deserve to be treated as such.

reviews.author: Martin Smith
reviews.text: The level of service provided is wholly unacceptable. It is unnecessarily difficult to obtain treatment for even the most straightforward medical issues. Reception staff appear intent on creating barriers rather than facilitating solutions, routinely deflecting requests by insisting patients complete PATCHS forms instead of offering practical assistance. Every enquiry or attempt to seek help is met with the same obstructive response: complete another PATCHS form. I am extremely frustrated with being forced to submit repeated forms, only to receive an inadequate outcome from a GP whom I am unable to speak with directly. When concerns are raised about the quality of care, reception simply reiterates the same dismissive instruction — submit yet another form. To make matters worse, PATCHS forms are not even accessible in the app after a certain time of day, further restricting access to care. This is an inefficient and poorly designed system, upheld by staff who appear disengaged and unhelpful. It gives the strong impression that administrative gatekeeping and cost control are being prioritised over patient care, leaving patients stressed, dissatisfied, and without the timely treatment they require for routine illnesses. Clearly I'm not the only one that's experiencing this poor, unacceptable service as the majority of reviews are of negative experiences and the star rating at the time of this review is less than 2 stars, which is shocking for a community medical practice. Really unacceptable.

reviews.text: It’s a terrible medical practice. More chance of finding a real doctor on the surface of the Moon. The receptionists soul purpose in life is to prevent you from getting any care. They constantly bombard you with texts and messages over some useless initiative some middle manager has dreamed up, all the while consistently failing to get even the very basics right.
